title: Warning: DO NOT DOWNLOAD – SCAM & FRAUDULENT CHARGES!
body:
I regret ever downloading this app. FABULOUS USES DECEPTIVE TACTICS TO TRAP USERS INTO UNWANTED CHARGES AND MAKES REFUNDS NEARLY IMPOSSIBLE. They force you to pay through their website instead of the App Store, so you CAN’T REQUEST A REFUND THROUGH APPLE. I canceled my subscription, yet they still charged me $40 WITHOUT WARNING! When I contacted them, they IGNORED MY REFUND REQUEST, just as they’ve done to many others.

After researching, I found COUNTLESS COMPLAINTS FROM USERS WHO CANCELED BUT KEPT GETTING CHARGED. Many feel helpless, unable to stop the charges or get their money back. THIS APP IS A WELL-CRAFTED SCAM DESIGNED TO DRAIN YOUR MONEY.

If Fabulous doesn’t issue a refund immediately and fix their shady practices, I WILL ENSURE MORE USERS ARE WARNED. EVERY NEGATIVE REVIEW WILL LOWER THEIR RATING AND REDUCE THEIR SUBSCRIPTIONS. Don’t fall into their trap—AVOID THIS APP AT ALL COSTS!

title: It’s fun and makes me more productive
body:
It’s so colorful and fun to use 
It makes me feel better about myself in many ways such as physical and mental health, and it helps creating a fun schedule and make it more enjoyable to fish every day by rewarding the user with complements after finishing a task and/or “habit “.
With every day they continue on a story of a journey that may look a lot like our stories which have difficulties like ours in real life. 

Also there’s a chat where you get to type whatever’s on your mind and even ask others in the chat for advice and/or help with something and there are some helpful replies.

I really recommend using the app, it’s fun and easy. and you get to choose what you want to add or remove from your list “ morning routine” or the afternoon one or the evening one .
author: rose ziegler

title: Just some random person who used a little bit the app
body:
I really hope the devs would read my review.
First, you can clearly see the amount of time and care took into developing this app, amazing, incredible, beautiful, thoughtful, smooth, not buggy and a lot of other good words.
But there are stuff that bothered me. When first entering the app I felt overwhelmed and found it a bit hard to navigate, and the tutorial was a little bit weird. I can’t tell exactly why. After figuring stuff out it feels that the app us a little bit forcing me into some tasks or routines that I don’t really want or need, like drinking water, which i do anyway and is trivial for me. This feature specifically feels a little bit spamming.
Second, there is a need for “undo” button, if I press accidentally and of course I do because I have ADHD - which seems to be the main audience for the app.
3rd, we are different people and we have different needs. I didn’t find the option to add my own kind of tasks, I’ll suggest to make a “favorite” tasks tabs that I can take out some of the built-ins and put my custom ones in for faster and less overwhelming approach.
4th, didn’t find category of cleaning tasks, I saw there is like a general task of cleaning something, but would it be great if it was a category with tasks that I can add to, and everyday the routine will generate one from the list according to my rate of importance and how often I did this one? I know it’s complicated to add such feature, but just giving an idea.
Suggestion - synchronize the iPhone calendar.
I have many more suggestion for this beautiful app, if you’d like to leave contact details and I’ll write you all and if you didn’t understand something of the above I’ll try explaining differently.
